Page 284 Cont.
June 23 Lillian Black - 28 - after 6 operations for tuomers is rather fearful lest threatening tuomers be malignant. She has five small children Must report at Hosp. in two weeks.
Mrs. Mary Abendroth - 76 - fearful back-aches ....
May Trobicinski - 48 - auto accident last Thursday - still unconscious
Page 285
June 23 Ed Cummings - 75 -
23 Boy-dround last Friday in P.H ..... not found .... Mother
Raymond Allen - 20 - tuomer at base of brain ... Drs. say no cure .... Mother - refuses to use Sacred Heart Badge. All three inscribed To- day in Ser. Masses.
25 Baby with strangled hernia - prayed for in March - here Today Drs. astonished about to operate found it not necessary. Deo Gr!
Janet Reich - n.c. - stiff limbs Murphy baby - 33 lbs ....
26 Alice Quinn - work -
Rose Kennedy - Enemia
Wm. Kennedy - drinking .... mental
Larry Bunting - 12 - brights - in bed since last January - quite bloated - not Catholic
John Kennedy - 42 - T.B. non Cath. - has wife and little girl of 8 yrs
Page 286 June 30 Angeline Bydalak - 37 - fears tuomer operation. Joseph St. Dennis - 71 - near mental ..... lives near Chatam. 1941, July July 2 July A. Maloney - young woman ...
